select material_id from jsh_project_material where project_id = #{projectId} and ifnull(delete_flag,'0') !='1'

select pm.material_id, m.name, mc.name as category_name, m.standard, m.model, jme.commodity_decimal, pm.quantity from jsh_project_material pm join ( select m2.id, min(me2.id) as me_id from jsh_material m2 left join jsh_material_extend me2 on m2.id = me2.material_id and ifnull(me2.delete_flag,'0') != '1' where ifnull(m2.delete_flag,'0') != '1' group by m2.id ) t on pm.material_id = t.id join jsh_material m on t.id = m.id left join jsh_material_category mc on m.category_id = mc.id left join jsh_material_extend jme on t.me_id = jme.id where pm.project_id = #{projectId} and ifnull(pm.delete_flag,'0') != '1'
